highlights.name: CVS 健康

highlights.name: 太阳药业
highlights.title: Sun Pharma Announces UNLOXCYT (cosibelimab-ipdl) Has Received a Category 2A Preferred Designation in the Updated NCCN Guidelines for Locally Advanced cSCC

highlights.name: 强生

highlights.summary: 新数据显示TREMFYA在伴肛周瘘管克罗恩病中实现持续至48周的瘘管缓解，100mg每8周组联合瘘管缓解率由第24周28%升至第48周35%。

highlights.name: 艾伯维
highlights.title: AbbVie Presents Data for ABBV-466, a Novel Dual-Targeting Therapy Demonstrating Higher Endoscopic Remission Rates Than Either Anti-IL-23 or Anti-α4β7 Monotherapy in Moderate to Severe Crohn's Disease

highlights.name: 阿斯利康
highlights.title: AstraZeneca to present overall survival data from four pivotal Phase III trials in Presidential Symposia at ESMO 2026 featuring Sone-Ve, Imfinzi, Tagrisso and Orpathys

highlights.name: 吉利德
highlights.title: Phase 2 SWIFT Study of Emvistegrast, a Potential Differentiated Once-daily Oral Treatment, Meets Primary Endpoint in Ulcerative Colitis

highlights.name: 吉利德
highlights.title: Gilead to Present New Data Across HIV and Emerging Antiviral Research at IDWeek 2026

highlights.name: 葛兰素史克

highlights.name: 武田药品
highlights.title: VERDICT (First Treat-to-Target Trial in UC) Meets Primary Endpoint

highlights.name: 西氏医药

highlights.name: 翰森制药

highlights.summary: 药明生物亮相2026年巴塞尔生物制剂节，展示将复杂科学转化为商业化确定性的能力。
